# The sorting room: plank floor (16 x 7.6 m), the back wall at z -3.4 (wallpaper over a teal
# wainscot and a tan dado rail), a window on the left, pigeonholes on the right, a round clock
# above the middle chute (its minute hand is the game bone `hand`). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Floor --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Paper --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Panel --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Rail --base-color 0.8196 0.6510 0.4941 --no-slot
material new Frame --base-color 0.8196 0.6510 0.4941 --no-slot
material new Pane --base-color 0.2353 0.4196 0.3922 --no-slot
material new Bar --base-color 0.7137 0.8118 0.5569 --no-slot
material new Back --base-color 0.3961 0.2510 0.3255 --no-slot
material new Letter --base-color 0.9647 0.9059 0.6118 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.6588 0.3765 0.3647 --no-slot
material new Face --base-color 0.9647 0.9059 0.6118 --no-slot
material new Tick --base-color 0.1216 0.1412 0.2941 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Floor --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.400 -0.050
scale 16.000 7.600 0.100
apply --scale
material assign Floor
active Floor
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
active Floor
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Floor base-color textures/floor.png
add mesh cube --name Paper --size 1 --location 0.000 3.450 3.150
scale 16.000 0.100 3.700
apply --scale
material assign Paper
active Paper
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
active Paper
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Paper base-color textures/wallpaper.png
add mesh cube --name Panel --size 1 --location 0.000 3.425 0.650
scale 16.000 0.150 1.300
apply --scale
material assign Panel
active Panel
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
active Panel
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Panel base-color textures/wainscot.png
add mesh cube --name Dado --size 1 --location 0.000 3.340 1.335
scale 16.000 0.120 0.170
apply --scale
material assign Rail
active Dado
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.5 || normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

export room.glb
